title: Add dynamic sitemap.xml for SEO — index all public listings + profiles
description: The sitemap.ts exists but doesn't include category pages, county pages, or paginated listing URLs. Expand it to include /listings?category=, /listings?county=, and /directory?category= routes. Add lastModified from the most recently updated item in each group. This drives organic discovery (growth). Acceptance: sitemap includes all dynamic route variants, passes Google Search Console validation, unit test covers URL count and structure.
notes: Expanded sitemap with grouped category/county/directory URLs plus paginated listing pages and unit coverage. Commit: 2ca5899.

title: Add browser push notification opt-in for new messages — retention loop
description: Add a OneSignal or web-push notification system that prompts members to enable browser notifications after their 2nd login. Send push when a new message arrives in a conversation. Store subscription in profiles.push_subscription (JSONB). Gate: only show opt-in to published profiles, respect browser permission state. Track opt-in rate in PostHog. Acceptance: push prompt shows after 2nd login, new message triggers push, subscription persists, unit tests cover opt-in logic and push send.
notes: Blocked: browser push delivery cannot be completed from repo state alone; missing VAPID/OneSignal credentials, subscription schema, and deployment wiring.

title: Add referral reward credits on successful invite conversion — viral monetization
description: When a referred user signs up AND publishes their profile, auto-award the inviter 10 credits. Add a 'Referral converted' quest (quest_referral_converted) worth 10 credits. Track conversion in PostHog (referral_converted). Show pending vs converted referrals in the dashboard ReferralInviteCard. Acceptance: credits awarded on profile publish (not just signup), quest completion tracked, dashboard shows conversion count, unit tests cover award logic and edge cases (duplicate, self-referral).
notes: Moved referral conversion rewards to profile publish, added referral_converted tracking plus pending/converted dashboard state and quest coverage. Commit: 630549f.

Acceptance: SMS and email buttons render on the dashboard card, generated URLs are stable and encoded, analytics fires with method=sms/email, and unit tests cover URL generation and click behavior.
notes: Added one-tap SMS and email referral sharing with analytics + unit coverage. Commit: ed69b6e.

notes: Added a stale-listing dashboard CTA that targets the oldest active zero-save listing older than 14 days, with unit coverage. Commit: fbc8b9f.
